posts.title: Welcome to FTI Protocol
posts.text:
Welcome to FTI Protocol.

This channel provides project announcements, platform updates and guidance on using the FTI ecosystem.

Website: https://ftiprotocol.com/
Member application: https://ftiprotocol.com/app/
Token application: https://ftiprotocol.com/token/

FTI operates on BNB Smart Chain mainnet. Review the details presented by the application and your wallet before authorizing any operation.

#FTI #FTIProtocol

posts.title: Introducing the FTI Ecosystem
posts.text:
FTI connects membership, a binary structure and a token model based on reserves.

The member application provides account information and management features. The token application presents token information and related operations.

Explore the platform:
https://ftiprotocol.com/

Further guidance will explain each component and its role within the ecosystem.

#FTI #PlatformOverview

posts.title: Connecting Your Wallet
posts.text:
Access the member application:
https://ftiprotocol.com/app/

1. Select the wallet connection option.
2. Choose the connection method supported by your wallet.
3. Confirm the network: BNB Smart Chain mainnet, chain ID 56.

Connecting a wallet does not complete registration or authorize a transaction. Review each subsequent request separately before approving it.

#FTI #UserGuide

posts.title: Using a Referral Link
posts.text:
If you received an FTI referral link, begin your registration process through that link.

Before confirming registration, compare the referrer address displayed in the application with the address provided to you. Resolve any discrepancy before proceeding.

If assistance is required, retain the referral link and the exact error message so the entry process can be reviewed.

#FTI #Registration

posts.title: Understanding the Reserve Model
posts.text:
Reserves and token supply contribute to the calculation of the FTI token's internal price.

This calculation does not guarantee returns or a fixed token price. Review current token information and the terms displayed for each operation.

Token application:
https://ftiprotocol.com/token/

#FTI #TokenEducation

posts.title: Identifying the FTI Token
posts.text:
A token name or symbol alone does not establish its identity. Verify both the network and the contract address.

Network: BNB Smart Chain mainnet
FTI token contract:

0x43755B1E813b2d41F669ea08bcf859De07195eA1

Compare this address with the current information published in the token application:
https://ftiprotocol.com/token/

#FTI #TokenContract

posts.title: Viewing Activity History
posts.text:
The activity history section displays the status of its data request.

In the updated application, leaving this section cancels a pending request. If new information cannot be retrieved, the notice appears within the history section.

When previously retrieved information is displayed, check the accompanying freshness notice. Confirm a transaction's final status in your wallet and the network explorer.

#FTI #MemberApplication

posts.title: Member Application Update
posts.text:
The FTI member application has been updated.

This release introduces clearer loading states and retry controls, improved activity request handling, a more compact membership card and updated light and dark theme controls.

Following installation, all 10 live browser checks passed across Chromium and WebKit. These checks were read-only and did not include a signed wallet registration or a real transaction.

Member application:
https://ftiprotocol.com/app/

#FTI #PlatformUpdate

posts.title: Requesting Technical Assistance
posts.text:
When reporting an issue, include the following information:

- The page you were using
- The action you attempted
- The exact error message
- Your device and browser
- The approximate time of the incident

A screenshot may help, provided confidential information has been removed. Do not disclose a wallet recovery phrase or private key.

Contact address listed on the website:
Support@FTIProtocol.com

#FTI #Support

posts.title: Getting Started: Common Questions
posts.text:
Is a wallet required to view public information?
Public information in the member and token applications can be viewed without connecting a wallet.

Does connecting a wallet complete registration?
Wallet connection, registration and transaction approval are separate steps.

Where should a new user begin?
https://ftiprotocol.com/app/

Refer to the introductory channel post for the main platform links.

#FTI #GettingStarted
